notes.readiness: DOC each readiness bar has a floor of 50% (7.6); passAt 60 is ASSUME: a bar at 60% and S = 1 gives the base score of 60 that design doc 8.9 puts at the pass threshold, so a full bar gives 100
notes.adenosine: DOC adenosine = 2 x sleep debt, at most 10, reforming after 6 s; three stacks fail the question being answered (8.9)
notes.cloakSeconds: DOC the morning coffee's cloak lasts at most 60 s in the fight (8.9); the residue decays on the boss clock (bossSecondsPerHour), so a cup of 100 blinds adenosine for 30 s and lets it see 2 tiles for 30 s more
notes.hitsForZero: ASSUME the hit part of the performance (25%, 8.9) falls by one eighth per hit taken in a segment; the design doc gives no mapping from hits
notes.segments: DOC a computer test of moving test cases and a written test of proof steps stamped in order, about 2 minutes each in two stages, with a barrage (7.6); question counts, times, case counts, speeds and barrage numbers are ASSUME
notes.bonus: DOC the bonus questions are 15% of the performance (8.9); one fast case per stage is ASSUME
